suite: r1066 actual navigation controller with controlled policy/gate endpoints

tests.name: Explicit reveal waits for a paint and uses existing policy with preventive focus
A later touch cancels delayed reveal and focus
A quiet scroll gate defers the request without changing its target
New input during quiet wait cancels the reveal even after release
The newest explicit destination retires the previous queued reveal
Closing/hiding or detaching the target before paint cannot scroll or focus it
Native tab click reveals selected content, while internal tab changes remain position-neutral
Arrow-key tab selection gets explicit reveal without synthesizing clicks
Tefekkür keeps its own scrollport and suppresses header tab auto-reveal
Default-prevented tab actions never queue another navigation
